about: Hypari's Accela filter (hypari-webcam smoothing.rs, from headcam-android and opentrack's filter-accela by Stanislaw Halik, ISC) on these inputs. Core's C++ and C# AccelaFilter match the outputs. Made by hypari-webcam's accela_cases test with ACCELA_CASES_WRITE set; do not edit by hand.

cases.name: a slow yaw turn at 60 Hz
a large yaw step, then held
30 Hz with gaps the filter crosses in steps and caps
a repeated time gives the last output
a turn past 180 degrees of yaw

units: yaw, pitch and roll in degrees; x, y and z in the tracker's unit; time in seconds
